name: Check Sky Light
description: Check Sky Light v3.6 is an empirical civilian sky diagnostics and aerospace deconfliction platform. Features real-time IMU optical tracking, live ADS-B & satellite deconfliction, 4-Pillar forensic review, Dual-Lens aerospace analysis, DTC P0312 Parallax Panel, and customizable Cockpit Archetypes (Black Project, Retro OBD-II, NVG/FLIR, Observatory).
